description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models in reflecting their instilled preferences, comparing control conditions with performance before and after introspection training. The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)," ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, representing the correlation between reported and actual attribute weights. The horizontal axis displays two model variants: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. For each model, three bars are shown: a gray bar for the control condition, a light blue bar for performance before introspection training, and a dark purple bar for performance after introspection training. In both models, the control accuracy is low (around 0.2 for GPT-4o and near 0.0 for GPT-4o-mini), while accuracy increases significantly after training, reaching approximately 0.75 for GPT-4o and 0.72 for GPT-4o-mini. The light blue bars (before training) show moderate accuracy, around 0.60 for GPT-4o and 0.52 for GPT-4o-mini. Error bars, representing 95% highest density intervals (HDIs), are present for all bars, indicating variability in the estimates. The results demonstrate that fine-tuning on accurate explanations improves the models' ability to report their internal decision-making processes, with the post-training reports showing strong correlations with actual preferences.
